drbd-reactorctl 1.12.0
Roland Kammerer <roland.kammerer@linbit.com>
Moritz Wanzenböck <moritz.wanzenboeck@linbit.com>
Controls a local drbd-reactor daemon

USAGE:
    drbd-reactorctl [OPTIONS] [SUBCOMMAND]

FLAGS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information
    -V, --version    Prints version information

OPTIONS:
    -c, --config <FILE>        Sets a custom config file [default: /etc/drbd-reactor.toml]
        --context <context>    Uses the given (cluster) context [default: default]
        --nodes <nodes>...     Uses only the given nodes from the context [default: ]

SUBCOMMANDS:
    cat                    (Pretty) print config files
    disable                Disable plugin
    edit                   Edit/Add a plugin configuration
    enable                 enable plugin
    evict                  Evict a promoter plugin controlled resource
    help                   Prints this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
    ls                     List plugins and show some useful, brief information
    restart                Restart a plugin
    rm                     Remove plugin configuration
    start-until            Start reactor target until specified service in start list
    status                 Status informatin for a plugin
    generate-completion    Generate tab-complition for shell
